name: CinemaCity Download Lab
description: CinemaCity Download Lab 1.9.0. Adds an adb logcat exfil channel (tag CCDUMP) that streams the full libs.js download-orchestration source off the device as numbered chunks, plus full chunked DUI8B diagnostic rows as a screenshot fallback. Scraper id and manifest path stay stable so Nuvio keeps your saved Session Cookie.
